records.text: Owens said a nurse purporting to have been at Timpanogos reported an allegedly unusual request for a chest saw; Owens repeatedly said allegedly and stated she was still verifying whether the nurse was there.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We also received a note from a nurse at Timpanogos, which LAPD told us that they were asking for weird things. ... Again, I'm going to say allegedly here, but that one of the things that they asked for, which they thought was out of the normal, was a chest saw. ... So this is a nurse at Timpanogos who purports to have been there, which I'm still working to verify, and that they requested a chest saw.
